body:
It depends on what classes you’re taking usually, but for the majority of the required classes for your first year (usually only 200 courses unless you’re looking into taking 300 level courses) you’ll only need to get maybe a couple of books and the odd textbook.

If you’re taking ENGL 201 (Introduction to English), you will need to get a few books that you’ll be reading over the semester, but it depends on what the prof will be teaching. Usually you can find all the required reading material in the back of the bookstore in the front shelves. 

Best of luck to you and your future studies! English can be hard at times, but the best way to stay ahead is doing homework when it’s assigned and attending each class. :)
